decisions.reason: Placing missing parts in the JLCPCB cart is an order-setup action and does not change the required BOM contents, part numbers, or board-specific BOM rule.
Adding missing parts to the cart does not alter the requirement to verify component orientations in the JLCPCB assembly preview.
The cart instruction does not add, remove, or change any required PCB production export file.
The client requests that missing parts be placed in the cart but does not change the component sourceability, availability, or compatible-alternative policies.
The order-cart action has no effect on connector pin labeling or its silkscreen location.
The source does not identify the battery connector or resolve any of its connector, pin-function, compatibility, or pin-order semantics.
Placing missing parts in the manufacturing cart does not change the power board's dimensions, orientation, mounting, clearance, or connector placement.
The source does not change any interboard connector type, pin count, pin order, pinout, or power-distribution topology.
The cart instruction does not affect connector placement, orientation, alignment, accessibility, or cable routing.
Adding missing parts to the cart leaves the three-board architecture and each board's functional role unchanged.
The source does not identify or change the charge-status LED, connector, resistor, population state, or indication path.
The generic instruction to place missing parts in the cart does not change the selected LED, supply voltage, data drive, level-shifter decision, or electrical acceptance condition.
